claims.text: His conclusion on the credentials: 'Lazar never attended either CalTech or MIT. Of this I am certain of beyond a reasonable doubt.' His investigation records that 'Standard inquiries have been made by George Knapp and Stanton Friedman and turned up nothing'; that Glenn Campbell in 1993 found no Lazar 'in any MIT student directory between 1978 and 1990'; and that Natalie Gilmore of Caltech Graduate Studies stated that Caltech 'does not currently have, nor has it ever had any sort of graduate degree in electronics or electronic technology'.

edges.label: The most detailed documentary examination of the account, 1990s and 2018
edges.note: 'Lazar never attended either CalTech or MIT. Of this I am certain of beyond a reasonable doubt.' The node carries his concessions as well as his conclusions, which is why this denial is worth more than a hostile one.
